description:
Operator smoke row 4 (PARTIAL). render_report() emits the S14 Inefficiency Callouts as bare integers: 'Failures: 865' names no tool and gives no denominator; 'Churn (consecutive-repeat retries): 222' names no tool. The counts are signal, not action -- an operator cannot tell whether 865 failures out of 12k calls is alarming, nor which tool to look at.

Fix: give each callout (a) a denominator against calls_joined or total output tokens, and (b) the top offending tool by count. Requires per-tool breakdown dicts on InefficiencyCounters for failures, oversized outputs, and churn (subagent fan-out and ToolSearch are already tool-specific).

In scope: toolbench/passive.py (InefficiencyCounters, Reducer.absorb, render_report) + tests/test_passive.py.
Out of scope: SPEC.md -- S14 fixes which callouts appear, not their formatting, so no spec change is needed.
Source: .lattice/orchestration/CLOSEOUT.md, 'Operator smoke results (2026-07-08)' row 4.
title: Inefficiency callouts lack denominators and attribution
